description: Issue taxonomy for feedback-improvement-loop. Buckets are tried in this order; the first whose tag alias equals a row tag wins, else the first whose keyword occurs in the lower-cased comment (or eval failure_reason), else 'other'. Edit keywords to fit your product; keep ids stable.

buckets.label: Hallucination / factually wrong
buckets.hypothesis: Answers are not grounded: retrieval misses or stale sources let the model fill gaps.
expected: Every factual claim is supported by a retrieved source or the answer says it does not know
No invented entities, numbers, dates or policies

buckets.label: Wrong format
buckets.hypothesis: Output format instructions or examples are missing or ambiguous for this feature.
expected: Output follows the feature's required format exactly
Length within the feature's stated limit

buckets.label: Too slow
buckets.hypothesis: Latency is driven by model size, prompt length or sequential tool calls on this path.
expected: Response completes within the feature's latency SLO (llm-observability)
Answer quality not reduced versus the current eval baseline

buckets.label: Unwarranted refusal
buckets.hypothesis: Guardrails or safety instructions block legitimate requests on this feature.
expected: Legitimate in-scope request is answered, not refused
Out-of-scope or unsafe variants are still refused

buckets.label: Missing information
buckets.hypothesis: The knowledge source lacks or has outdated content for these questions.
expected: Answer includes the information the user needed, sourced from current content
If the content does not exist, the answer says so and routes to a human

buckets.label: Tone
buckets.hypothesis: Voice and tone guidance is missing or inconsistent in the system prompt.
expected: Tone matches the product voice guide

buckets.label: Other / needs triage
buckets.hypothesis: Not matched to a known bucket; needs human triage before a fix is chosen.
expected: Behaviour the user expected, as written in their comment, is met
